blocks.text: Safe, code-compliant central gas system design and installation for hotels, homes, and commercial towers across the UAE — DOE and ADCD approved.

Managing individual gas cylinders at every kitchen or point of use gets harder to control as a building gets bigger — more units to track, more changeovers, more room for something to be missed. Central gas system installation solves that by feeding the entire building from one regulated source, and it's why hospitals, hotels, and residential towers across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Sharjah increasingly move to it once individual cylinder management stops making sense.As a leading central gas company in the UAE, Firestone designs, installs, and maintains central gas systems for property developers, facility managers, and building owners from the initial layout through to ongoing servicing — including central gas system installation for homes and residential towers, not just commercial developments. Every system is sized to the building's actual gas demand rather than a standard template, and installed to meet civil defence and DOE requirements from the outset.

blocks.alt: Central gas system installation pipework with pressure gauges and shut-off valves

blocks.text: We design and install central gas system installations from the ground up — sizing the source, laying out distribution pipework, and setting pressure regulation points so every connected unit gets a stable, correct supply. Whether it's a residential tower or villa in Dubai, a hospital in Abu Dhabi, or a hotel in Sharjah, the installation is planned around the building's actual layout and demand before a single pipe goes in — including central gas tank installation where bulk storage suits the site better than a piped-only feed.Installation work runs alongside the building's construction or fit-out schedule where needed, with pipe routing coordinated against other trades so gas distribution doesn't conflict with electrical, plumbing, or HVAC runs. Every stage gets signed off before the next begins, and the finished system is pressure-tested across its full length before we hand it over.

Once live, a central gas system needs regular checks to stay reliable — regulators drift, pipework needs inspection, and shut-off points have to be confirmed working. We provide scheduled maintenance and AMC coverage for central gas systems in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain, with full details on what's included on our Gas Maintenance & AMC page.
Why Buildings Move to a Central Gas System

A central gas system removes the need for tenants or facility staff to manage cylinder changeovers unit by unit, which matters most in towers and mixed-use developments where individual gas cylinders become a logistical and safety headache at scale. One regulated source, monitored centrally, is simpler to maintain and easier to keep compliant than dozens of separate cylinder points.It also changes who's responsible for what — with individual cylinders, gas safety is effectively split across every tenant or unit, each managing their own supply, storage, and changeover schedule. With a central gas system, that responsibility sits with one point of accountability, usually the property manager or owner working directly with us, which makes compliance easier to track and reduces the number of places something can go wrong across a large building.

We deliver central gas system installation projects across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain, with the same design and installation process whether it's a single residential tower, a villa, or a multi-building development. Our engineers handle site assessment locally, so the system design reflects the actual property and gas demand rather than a generic template.

blocks.alt: Engineers reviewing central gas system installation drawings for civil defence approval

blocks.text: Central gas systems installed in the UAE must meet civil defence and DOE requirements at every stage, from initial design through to final commissioning — this isn't an optional add-on, it's a condition of the building being legally allowed to operate on gas at all.We manage that process directly rather than leaving it for the property owner to chase separately, including full central gas system certificationand civil defence sign-off required before the system can be commissioned.That means preparing technical drawings, submitting material and system specifications in the format the relevant authority expects, and coordinating inspections through to certification. Once approved, the system's documentation stays on file, so if civil defence or DOE ever request records during a routine or renewal inspection, they're already in order and ready to hand over.
Everything you need to know about central gas systems

items.q: What is a central gas system?
items.a: A central gas system distributes gas to an entire building or development from a single regulated source, replacing the need for individual gas cylinders at each point of use.

items.q: Is a central gas system suitable for homes, villas, and residential towers?
items.a: Yes — central gas systems work for single villas and homes as well as residential towers, hotels, and hospitals, wherever managing individual cylinders across multiple units or a larger property becomes impractical.

items.q: How much does a central gas system installation cost?
items.a: Cost depends on building size, gas load, and pipework distance, so pricing is based on a site assessment rather than a flat rate. We aim to keep every project competitively priced for its scope — get in touch for a quote specific to your property.

items.q: How often does a central gas system need maintenance?
items.a: Central gas systems need regular inspection to stay compliant and reliable. See our Gas Maintenance & AMC page for full details on scheduled servicing and coverage areas.

items.q: Does Firestone handle central gas system approvals?
items.a: Yes, we manage civil defence and DOE compliance for every central gas system project, from design submission through final certification.
